en: A vintage monochrome New Year greeting card dated 1890. The main text 'Godt nytt år!' is written in ornate script across a decorative banner with floral and grain motifs and a circular ornamental pattern behind it. Below is a cursive message in Swedish or closely related Scandinavian language, and in the lower right corner appears the sender's name 'E. Nylund.' The card has rounded corners and a simple cream background.
